story.text: Anne joins her father and Elizabeth in their fine rooms in Bath. Sir Walter admires himself in every {GLASS}, and counts the plain {FACES} in the street; Mrs. Clay never leaves Elizabeth’s side. Mr. Elliot, long {ESTRANGED}, now calls every day, so {CHARMING} and {SENSIBLE} that only Anne wonders what he {WANTS}. Her one pleasure is an old school friend, Mrs. Smith, poor and ill.
story.caption: Few women could think more of their personal appearance than he did
